sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's >>=  operator silently propagates Nothing through a chain of computations, collapsing everything that follows the first absence.
sketches.resonance: Once someone is gone, every future you planned with them evaluates to Nothing — and the type system ensures you cannot pretend otherwise.
sketches.draft:
after :: Maybe a -> Maybe a
after you =
  you
  >>= return
  >>= return
  >>= return
  >>= return

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no matching row exists on the right, filling the missing side with NULL.
sketches.resonance: You carry every moment you lived together, but their half of the record is forever NULL — present in structure, absent in substance.
sketches.draft:
SELECT
  days.moment,
  you.presence
FROM days
LEFT JOIN you
  ON days.moment = you.moment;

sketches.mechanism: A pointer continues to hold an address after the memory it points to has been freed — a dangling pointer that the language does nothing to prevent.
sketches.resonance: The reference remains long after what it referred to is gone; using it is undefined behavior, but you reach for it anyway.
